say:2:1130973001:1.text: So that means you have seen Tibu?!
say:2:1130973001:1.source_cn: 这么说，你在附近见过提布了？
say:2:1130973001:1.male: So that means you have seen Tibu?!
say:2:1130973001:1.female: So that means you have seen Tibu?!

say:3:1130973002:1.text: That's great! I knew it! That means he's waiting for us to find him nearby!
say:3:1130973002:1.source_cn: 太好了！我就知道，他肯定没跑远，正等着我们去找他呢！

say:4:1130973003:1.text: But we've searched all around... should we go a little further?
say:4:1130973003:1.source_cn: 可是，这附近我们都找遍了……是不是该走远一点呢？
